biggest_catch: This is a loan referral, not a membership referral - you earn nothing unless the friend actually closes on a $5,000+ loan with a 24+ month term (the bonus is per new member/borrower, not per loan).
catches: Friend must: establish a $5 Share Savings and close on an eDCU loan of at least $5,000 with a minimum term of 24 months.
$50 paid to the referring member within two weeks of loan funding.
Bonus granted per new member/borrower, not per new loan funded.
No limit on the number of referrals.
evergreenDIRECT can cancel the promotion at any time without prior notification.
Referral bonus to the existing member may be subject to tax reporting for amounts over $600.
